component.name: Atril
Atril
component.summary: Read and synchronize a federated e-book library
Leia e sincronize uma biblioteca de e-books federada

description.p: Atril is the reading application for Quire, a federated e-book library. The library, the reading positions and the annotations live on the device: the network is an optimization and not a requirement, and a book opened on a train is a book that can be read there.

Changes made offline are authored locally and replicated to the reader's other devices, and to whichever nodes they have authorized to hold a copy, when a node can next be reached. A reader can move their account to a different node without losing their library, their marks or the page they were on.
EPUB is the format that can be read. The others are imported, listed, synchronized and shown with a reading percentage.
